bagPolicy.summary: Small clutches, wristlets, or fanny packs no bigger than 6”x 9” and clear plastic bags no bigger than 12"x12"x6” are allowed. All bags are subject to search upon entry.
allowed: Clear plastic bags no bigger than 12"x12"x6”
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking is available at lots surrounding the waterfront with varying prices. For easier entry and exit, consider Premier Parking or VIP Parking. Accessible parking is available, with Lot 1 being the closest to the venue.

rideshare.note: Use the designated rideshare areas at Wiggins Circle at the end of Martin Luther King Boulevard, or Clinton Street and 3rd Street. Both drop-off points are about half a block from the venue.

concessions.note: Freedom Mortgage Pavilion offers a variety of food and drink options including Mosh Burger's hormone-free beef burgers, Rebel Hen's crispy chicken tenders, and Ziggy's Magic Pizza Shop's NY-inspired pizzas. Koko's Bavarian provides German-inspired sausages and pretzels, while CVT offers premium soft serve ice cream. General concessions include popcorn, nachos, and a selection of alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Limited storage is available for wheelchairs, canes, walkers, and other mobility devices.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not permitted after you leave the venue.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: On show days, the box office opens 60 minutes before door time. During the summer season it is also open Fridays from 10am to 3pm, and it is closed in the off-season. If a ticket needs to be reprinted during the event, visit the box office (a fee applies), or call 856.365.1300.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Gates usually open 60 to 90 minutes before showtime, so check your ticket confirmation for the exact door time. Tailgaters are asked to head inside once the gates open.
